newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RENAULT PORTUGAL WORKERS NOT TO STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: RENAULT PORTUGAL WORKERS NOT TO STRIKE.

text.p: Portuguese labour unions at French carmaker Renault do not plan to stage a stoppage on Friday to coincide with protests at Renault sites in Belgium, France and Spain, a spokeswoman said.

"No strike is expected, although we will probably pass a motion at a plenary meeting tomorrow to express our solidarity with our colleagues in Europe," Emilia Sousa of the Renault Workers' Commission told Reuters.

Labour unions at Renault said on Monday they were calling for a one-hour stoppage at all Renault plants in France, Belgium and Spain in reaction to the announced closure of the Vilvoorde plant near Brussels and expected job losses in France.
Plants at Setubal and Cacia in central Portugal assemble Renault Clio saloons.
